rule_for_changes: No threshold, count, rule or list in this file is changed after a result from a layout-sweep run exists. If one looks unfair, the result is reported against it as written and the objection is written beside it.

design.placements: 16 in mode fine, 4 in mode coarse (see modes)
design.pad_step_bytes: 4 in mode fine, 16 in mode coarse
design.pad_ids: p00..; placement pNN puts step*NN bytes of 0x90 filler before the kernel function
design.order: ABBA (A = NONE, B = FAST), one process per repetition, taskset-pinned, via harness/run.py pair()

fine.flags: first of design.loop_alignment_variants_in_order that passes the probe

coarse.note: compiler default function and loop alignment (loops at multiples of 16 bytes): the only loop-start residues mod 64 the compiler produces by itself are 0, 16, 32, 48

mode_order: fine is tried first (all loop-alignment variants, addresses only); if none moves the loop in 4-byte steps, coarse runs; a run never mixes modes and records which ran in mechanism.mode
